steps: Attach the X axis to the same logical machine as the A axis
Verify the X and A axes are on the same logical machine before attempting to link them with Electronic Cam
Check the Joint logical machine parameter for the X axis to ensure it matches the A axis's logical machine number
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the axis's current logical machine assignment
Set the Joint logical machine parameter for the axis to logical machine 1
Verify the axis is detached from logical machine 2 and attached to logical machine 1
Check the part program search hierarchy configuration
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the search hierarchy paths
Check the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' is not overridden by another program in the search hierarchy
Add at least 3 control points between splineon and splineoff commands
Verify the spline type and parameters are correctly specified in the splineon block
Ensure no sync command is used between splineon and splineoff without proper reinitialisation
Edit the block to remove all but one class 1 preparatory word.
Check the joint logical device settings to ensure logical device 5 is assigned to only one joint.
Verify the logical device number 5 is uniquely mapped in the device configuration.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license status to confirm the OPC UA server option is not included.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if needed.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
If the device is in SAFEOP but expected to be in OP, restart the drive
If the alarm is informational, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed.
Restart the system to recover from the emergency state
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus to reset the drive's error state
Check the drive's reported error register for additional details
If the error code is zero, acknowledge the message; no further action is needed
Restart the system to recover from the error
Check the Ethercat master log file for detailed error information
Upload firmware for Drive_3 using the correct file path
Restart AMCore in device mode
Verify firmware version after upload completes
Check the firmware version from the device matches the expected version
